  local alevel     = num(attacker.level, 0)
  local crit_chance= num(attacker.crit_chance, 0)
  local crit_mult  = num(attacker.crit_mult, 150)

  local maxhp      = hp

  local armor      = num(defender.armor, 0)
  local dlevel     = num(defender.level, 0)
  local delem      = defender.element or 'neutral'
  local resist     = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding   = (defender.guarding and true) or false

  local hits       = num(skill.hits, 1)
  local true_damage= (skill.true_damage and true) or false
  local seed       = num(skill.seed, 0)

  local absorbed = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local killed = false

  local k = 0

    k = k + 1
    resolved = k

    local p = power - 20 * (k - 1)
    if p < 10 then p = 10 end
    local d = math.floor(atk * p / 100)

    local diff = clamp(alevel - dlevel, -10, 10)
    d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3 * diff) / 100)

    local crit = ((seed + 17 * k) % 100) < crit_chance
    if crit then
      crits = crits + 1
      d = math.floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
    end

    local immune = false
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if crit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))

    end

    shield = shield,
    overkill = overkill,

{"code":"local KNOWN = {none=true,poison=true,stun=true,cleave=true,shield=true,heal=true}
local st = nil

local function num(v,d) local n = tonumber(v); if n == nil then return d end; return math.floor(n) end

local function clone_team(list, team)
  local out = {}
  if type(list) ~= 'table' then return out end
  for i = 1, #list do
    local s = list[i]
    if type(s) == 'table' then
      local hp = num(s.hp,1)
      out[#out+1] = {
        id = tostring(s.id), team = team,
        hp = hp, max_hp = hp,
        atk = num(s.atk,0), def = num(s.def,0), spd = num(s.spd,0), cd = num(s.cd,1),
        skill = tostring(s.skill or 'none'),
        shield = 0, poison = 0, stun = 0, cooldown = 0,
      }
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function start(a,b)
  local s = {units={}, all={}, team={A={},B={}}, round=0, order={}, pos=1, over=false, result='running'}
  for _,t in ipairs({{a,'A'},{b,'B'}}) do
    local arr = clone_team(t[1], t[2])
    for _,u in ipairs(arr) do
      s.units[u.id] = u
      s.all[#s.all+1] = u
      local tl = s.team[t[2]]
      tl[#tl+1] = u.id
    end
  end
  st = s
  return true
end

local function other(t) if t == 'A' then return 'B' end return 'A' end

local function alive(u) return u.hp > 0 end

local function check_end()
  local ca, cb = 0, 0
  for _,id in ipairs(st.team.A) do if alive(st.units[id]) then ca = ca + 1 end end
  for _,id in ipairs(st.team.B) do if alive(st.units[id]) then cb = cb + 1 end end
  if ca == 0 or cb == 0 then
    st.over = true
    if ca == 0 and cb == 0 then st.result = 'draw'
    elseif cb == 0 then st.result = 'A'
    else st.result = 'B' end
  end
end

local function pick_enemy(U)
  local best = nil
  for _,id in ipairs(st.team[other(U.team)]) do
    local u = st.units[id]
    if alive(u) then
      if not best then best = u else
        local bs, us = best.hp + best.shield, u.hp + u.shield
        if us < bs or (us == bs and (u.hp < best.hp or (u.hp == best.hp and u.id < best.id))) then best = u end
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

local function pick_low_hp_ally(U)
  local best = nil
  for _,id in ipairs(st.team[U.team]) do
    local u = st.units[id]
    if alive(u) then
      if not best then best = u else
        if u.hp < best.hp or (u.hp == best.hp and u.id < best.id) then best = u end
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

local function pick_most_wounded_ally(U)
  local best = nil
  for _,id in ipairs(st.team[U.team]) do
    local u = st.units[id]
    if alive(u) then
      if not best then best = u else
        local g, bg = u.max_hp - u.hp, best.max_hp - best.hp
        if g > bg or (g == bg and u.id < best.id) then best = u end
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

local function hit(U,T)
  local dmg = U.atk - T.def
  if dmg < 1 then dmg = 1 end
  local a = T.shield
  if a > dmg then a = dmg end
  T.shield = T.shield - a
  T.hp = T.hp - (dmg - a)
  if T.hp <= 0 then T.hp = 0 end
end

local function use_skill(U)
  local sk = U.skill
  if not KNOWN[sk] or sk == 'none' then
    local T = pick_enemy(U); if T then hit(U,T) end
  elseif sk == 'poison' then
    local T = pick_enemy(U)
    if T then
      hit(U,T)
      if alive(T) then
        local p = T.poison + 2
        if p > 6 then p = 6 end
        T.poison = p
      end
    end
  elseif sk == 'stun' then
    local T = pick_enemy(U)
    if T then
      hit(U,T)
      if alive(T) then T.stun = 1 end
    end
  elseif sk == 'cleave' then
    local victims = {}
    for _,id in ipairs(st.team[other(U.team)]) do
      local u = st.units[id]
      if alive(u) then victims[#victims+1] = u end
    end
    for i = 1, #victims do
      local T = victims[i]
      if alive(T) then hit(U,T) end
    end
  elseif sk == 'shield' then
    local A = pick_low_hp_ally(U)
    if A then
      local s = A.shield + 2 * U.atk
      if s > 20 then s = 20 end
      A.shield = s
    end
  elseif sk == 'heal' then
    local A = pick_most_wounded_ally(U)
    if A then
      local h = A.hp + 2 * U.atk
      if h > A.max_hp then h = A.max_hp end
      A.hp = h
    end
  end
end

local function new_round()
  st.round = st.round + 1
  if st.round > 20 then
    st.over = true; st.result = 'draw'; st.order = {}; st.pos = 1
    return false
  end
  local arr = {}
  for i = 1, #st.all do
    local u = st.all[i]
    if alive(u) then arr[#arr+1] = u end
  end
  table.sort(arr, function(x,y)
    if x.spd ~= y.spd then return x.spd > y.spd end
    if x.hp ~= y.hp then return x.hp > y.hp end
    return x.id < y.id
  end)
  st.order = arr; st.pos = 1
  return true
end

local function step()
  if not st or st.over then return 'end' end
  local U = nil
  while true do
    if st.pos > #st.order then
      if not new_round() then return 'end' end
    end
    while st.pos <= #st.order do
      local u = st.order[st.pos]
      if alive(u) then U = u; break end
      st.pos = st.pos + 1
    end
    if U then break end
    st.order = {}; st.pos = 1
  end
  st.pos = st.pos + 1
  if U.poison > 0 then
    U.hp = U.hp - U.poison
    U.poison = U.poison - 1
    if U.hp <= 0 then
      U.hp = 0
      check_end()
      return U.id
    end
  end
  if U.cooldown > 0 then U.cooldown = U.cooldown - 1 end
  if U.stun > 0 then
    U.stun = U.stun - 1
    return U.id
  end
  if U.skill ~= 'none' and U.cooldown == 0 and KNOWN[U.skill] then
    use_skill(U)
    U.cooldown = U.cd
  else
